title and abstract.summary: This study measured the functional traits of plants and pollinators across 51 grasslands to explore how honeybee abundance, temperature, plant functional diversity, and trait similarity between wild pollinators and the honeybee affect resource overlap between wild pollinators and the honeybee.

introduction.summary: The study examines the functional traits of both plants and pollinators to help identify the likelihood, strength, and direction of interactions between managed and wild pollinators. This study investigated how functional traits of plants and pollinators, along with the abundance of honeybees and temperature, affected the foraging behavior of wild pollinators, specifically exploring how plant community functional richness and dispersion influenced resource overlap between wild pollinators and the honeybee.
